recipe.visualDefinition: A classic 1960s album cover featuring a studio portrait of a male and female duo against a solid magenta-plum background. The male figure is in a white tuxedo, and the female figure is in a black dress, positioned on the right side of the frame. The left side is dedicated to a multi-tiered typographic layout using a mix of ultra-condensed sans-serifs and a flowing, high-contrast italic script.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast interaction between the white tuxedo and the dark magenta background.
Typographic balance between the rigid top header and the fluid central title.
Subject placement on the right third, creating a large negative space for text on the left.
Color harmony between the warm skin tones and the cool magenta backdrop.
coreInvariants: Studio lighting with soft shadows on the subjects.
Mix of three distinct typographic styles: condensed sans, elegant script, and small block sans.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects are positioned in the lower right quadrant, scaled to approximately 60% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The male figure's white tuxedo acts as the primary visual anchor due to its brightness.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top-left header, move down through the script title, and settle on the smiling faces of the subjects.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large open area in the upper left and middle left for primary and secondary text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep magenta/plum background providing a saturated, moody base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for the male's tuxedo and the primary header text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden-yellow/orange for the central script title.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background contrasted with high-value white and low-value black clothing.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Mix of ultra-condensed grotesque and high-contrast calligraphic script.
letterConstructionRules: Header uses extremely tight tracking and tall x-heights.
Script title features long, sweeping ascenders and descenders with variable stroke width.
Tracklist uses a clean, utilitarian sans-serif in all caps.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'g' in header has a simplified, modern loop.
Script 'y' and 'l' have exaggerated, decorative tails.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Triadic typographic contrast: rigid geometric header, organic fluid title, and functional block metadata.
graphicDevices: Small rectangular logo frame in top right corner

preserve: The ultra-condensed nature of the top text
The high-contrast slant of the script

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the tall, narrow profile of the header text.
Captures the mid-century calligraphic feel of the central title.
Appropriate for the secondary tracklist information.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio photograph of a man in a white tuxedo and a woman in a black dress, both smiling and looking at each other, positioned on the right side. The background is a flat, solid magenta-plum color with a slight vintage film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large ultra-condensed sans-serif header in white at the top left. Below it, add a large, flowing calligraphic script title in golden-yellow. In the lower left, add a list of text in a small, white, condensed sans-serif font with bullet points.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid, non-gradient magenta?
Are the subjects positioned primarily on the right side?
Is there a clear contrast between the white, yellow, and magenta elements?
Does the script text have exaggerated, elegant flourishes?

adjustableVariables: Background color hue (e.g., deep blue or forest green)

avoid: Modern sans-serifs like Arial or Calibri

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible against the magenta background.
Verify the white tuxedo doesn't blow out and retains fabric detail.
Check that the script font doesn't overlap the subjects' faces.
Confirm the overall layout feels like a physical 12-inch vinyl sleeve.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a solid saturated backdrop with a right-aligned duo portrait and a left-aligned three-tier typographic hierarchy using condensed and script fonts.
